source_trace.title: Treasury to Provide Loan to YRC Worldwide | U.S. Department of the Treasury
source_trace.publication_evidence: July 1, 2020 WASHINGTON – Today the U.S. Department of the Treasury announced that it intends to make a $700 million loan to YRC Worldwide Inc.

impact_scope_evidence.quote: YRC provides 68% of less-than-truckload services to the Department of Defense and is a leading provider of critical military transportation and other hauling services to the U.S.
impact_scope_evidence.rationale: The article highlights YRC's role in providing critical military transportation and hauling services to the U.S. government, indicating an industry-wide impact on the transportation services sector.

impact_scope_evidence.quote: The decision was based on a certification by the Secretary of Defense that YRC is critical to maintaining national security.
impact_scope_evidence.rationale: This statement confirms the importance of YRC's services to national security, which is a sector-wide impact on the military and government services industry.

impact_scope_evidence.quote: The agreement will also include provisions to maintain employment levels and limit executive compensation, dividends, and share repurchases.
impact_scope_evidence.rationale: This indicates broader implications for the transportation services industry, particularly in terms of employment and financial practices.

scope_evidence.evidence_quote: The loan was part of the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security Act (CARES Act), and the Treasury had reached an agreement with YRC on June 30, 2020, to receive a 29.6% equity stake in the company.
scope_evidence.rationale: The loan and equity stake are part of a U.S. government initiative under the CARES Act, which is a broad U.S. equity market policy.
